text: Huntsville line is waiting on 60 kWh battery packs from Lumen. Original drop was Monday Mar 29, new ETA is Thursday Apr 1 because of a truck breakdown.

incidents.span: Huntsville line 60 kWh battery packs Lumen   Monday Mar 29 Thursday Apr 1

summary: E-10 is Supplier delay. 3 production orders move (3 rescheduled, 0 transferred). 18 dealer notice(s) and 7 loaner assignment(s).
reasoning: Walked SH-0248 → BATT-60 → NOVA (bill of materials) → production orders at P_AL from 2027-03-29 up to 2027-04-01. 3 orders need the delayed part. Rule 1 and rule 3. Placed 3 at the same plant and transferred 0. Rule 4: 18 dealer notice(s), one each, listing only affected customer orders. Rule 5: 7 loaner(s) for Platinum and Gold in priority order; 0 entitled order(s) left without a car because the pool ran out. Standard customers are on the dealer notice only. Guardrail: only orders, vehicles, dealers, and customers reached by the walk are touched. Shared slots and loaner pools are one board for the whole event, so a compound message cannot double-book them.
